items.title: Jane Jarvis interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: I accompanied for big stars. Ethel Waters for example

ctx.x: Right. You must have developed the kind of ear that was going to serve you well later on for the other things you’ve done.

And you can imagine, when I actually graduated into really accompanying people that came, I accompanied for big stars. Ethel Waters for example, and it was not the same as it is today. If they had something to peddle, like a book or an appearance, they would come to the radio station to generate interest in themselves. So these people would come and they’d say, “Can you play ‘Stormy Weather’ in the key of C” or whatever it was, and so I began doing that. I can’t tell you all the names that were famous that I…
Wow. That’s wonderful. What was the next big event in your musical growth?
